statement: Sourced knowledge systems can preserve multiple conflicting assertions and contextual qualifiers without choosing a single truth.
actakit_implication: ActaKit should store source-bounded claims and contradictions, not a universal truth value.

statement: Some qualifiers are meaning-changing, especially time, jurisdiction and scope.
actakit_implication: Pre-SQL fixtures must test whether claim scope needs explicit structured qualifiers, but avoid a universal qualifier graph.

statement: A claim should remain meaningful and verifiable even when machine-readable context is absent.
actakit_implication: Structured qualifiers/enrichments should augment rather than define the proposition.
